gloss: breach (in a levee or embankment); break point

definitions.gloss: breach in a levee, dike, or embankment; the point where a barrier has given way
definitions.explanation: The physical gap where a levee, dike, or other water-retaining structure has collapsed under pressure, allowing water to flow through. Appears often in disaster and flood reporting, especially after heavy rain or typhoons in Japan.

examples.japanese: {決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}ぐ→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧。
examples.english: To block the breach in the levee.

examples.japanese: {決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}れ{込|こ}んだ→流れ込む：05748_nagarekomu⟧。
examples.english: A large volume of water poured into the town from the breach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じ→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧、⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{余儀|よぎ}なく→余儀なく：28255_yoginaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A breach formed in the embankment because of the typhoon, forcing nearby residents to evacuate.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{決壊|けっかい}→決壊：15288_kekkai⟧ ('collapse, bursting — of an embankment or levee') + {口|ぐち} ('opening, mouth'). The second element reads as 'ぐち' (rendaku from くち) because it is the second element of a compound. A term almost exclusive to flood and disaster reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}ぐ→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧: to plug/block the breach
- {決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れ{込|こ}む→流れ込む：05748_nagarekomu⟧: water flows in through the breach
- {決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修復|しゅうふく}→修復：11544_shuufuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to repair the breach
- {決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: the breach widens
- {決壊|けっかい}{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧: a breach forms/arises

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{決壊|けっかい}→決壊：15288_kekkai⟧: (noun/⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb) collapse or bursting of a levee or embankment
- ⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧: levee, embankment, dike
- {土|ど}のう: sandbag — commonly used to block a breach
- ⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧: flooding; overflowing of a river
- ⟦{浸水|しんすい}→浸水：14945_shinsui⟧: flooding, inundation (of an area with water)
- {越水|えっすい}: water overtopping a levee (without breaking it) — contrast with ⟦{決壊|けっかい}→決壊：15288_kekkai⟧

USAGE:
Highly specialized to flood-disaster contexts. Heard frequently on NHK disaster bulletins and in newspaper coverage of typhoon damage.
